item.title: [SwiftHFR] LOT-097: align the BBCode renderer with the batch 2 previews R443a-R443n (#742)
item.body:
LOT-097

Refs #742 (everything the nine facts ask is matched or documented; the follow-ups are in #796, so `Refs` rather than `Closes`: the acceptance line "pending list keeps only item 10" is not literally met, see below)
Claim: cloud/i742-sonnet

**Problem.** HFR's batch 2 previews (`R443a`-`R443n`, PR #741) contradict several defaults of the LOT-097 renderer.

**Cause.** Those defaults were chosen before any capture (spec "Pending capture" 1-9).

**Change** (`HFRParsing/BBCode`, one fact at a time):
1. Syntax colours for `cpp` and `code` (captured keywords, `//` comments with the line's CR); `[c]` `[java]` `[php]` `[html]` stay text.
2. Raw blocks: `[b]` rendered in `code`; `[fixed]` around a block loses its tags; `[code]` in `[cpp]` and `[fixed]` in `[code]`/`[cpp]` render inside the item, content escaped and coloured again.
3. `[b][/b]` is text; a `[b]` pair holding a block loses its tags.
4. Quotes: two levels at most.
5. Smileys: substituted in URLs too (a `[url]` made text), except the `:/` of `://`; bare `http(s)` URLs are linked up to the smiley; a `)` after a typed `"` or `&` gets a space.
6. Colour: the open pairs with the first colour close, any name or case; 3-digit hex.
7. Whitespace: a single leading space of a code line stays plain. The message start is **not** a line start: `R443g` bytes are `   ` (the issue's wording is contradicted; the renderer was already right, now asserted).
8. Bullets: consecutive `[*]` lines are one list; the CR after a consumed break stays plain.
9. URLs: `www.` now gets `http://`; `[img]` takes only `http://`, `https://`, `ftp://`; a typed `"` in a URL attribute is written `&#034;` as HFR does; the sanitizer keeps its own rule (intentional difference 2).

Spec: defaults replaced with the captured behaviour and its capture; pending 1-9 removed; what no capture shows is listed as pending 11 instead of guessed (keyword set, bare-URL terminators, `i`/`u`/`strike`, nested-block escaping, …). That is why the pending list is not only item 10. Follow-ups: #796 (quote shape `oldquote` vs `quote`, `[quotemsg]`, `[email]`, codes `:p:` / `:D:` missing from the catalogue, damaged `request_body` of `R443c`/`R443f`).

**Tests.** `BBCodeRendererBatch2OracleTests` (one per fact, against the previews, reductions counted) and `HFRBBCodeWriterBatch2Tests`. The oracle tests were committed red first (commit `Add oracle tests…`, 21 failing expectations across the 9 tests), then green with the renderer commit. `swift test` in `Packages/HFRKit`: 1940 passed; `swiftlint --strict` clean on the touched folders. Existing writer and sanitization tests that encoded the old defaults were updated (listed in the diff).

comments.body:
Adversarial review, round 1 (Opus 5.5, read-only subagent), verdict verbatim:

> **Revue adversariale (Opus 5.5) : CHANGEMENTS DEMANDÉS** — tête aad6c3d
>
> 1. **Major**, `BBCodeRendererBatch2OracleTests.swift:179,184` and `LOT-097…md:108,119`. The fact 9 test lets any line containing `&b=` or `//example` differ, and only requires `matched >= 5`. The spec says the opposite: "every http(s)/www line equals HFR's" and "the normalizer reads both as the same URL". The capture disagrees. For `[url]https://example.invalid/?a=1&b="2"[/url]`, HFR's link becomes `…&b="2&%23034;` and ours becomes `…&b=%222%22`. For the matching `[img]`, `src`, `alt` and `title` all differ. Fix: escape the attribute twice, as HFR does (`HFRBBCodeWriter.swift:115,119`, and `[img]` at `:104`). Otherwise, list the difference with its reason. In the test, replace the `contains` escape hatch with the exact indices of the lines expected to differ.
> 2. **Major**, `HFRBBCodeWriter.swift:104`. For `[img]//example.invalid/a.png[/img]`, the renderer shows an image from `https://example.invalid/a.png`, but HFR leaves the tag as text (`R443f`). For `[img]javascript:alert(1)[/img]`, the renderer removes everything, but HFR shows the text. Intentional difference 2 does not cover either case, and the escape hatch from finding 1 hides both. Fix: accept an `[img]` URL only when it starts with `http://`, `https://` or `ftp://`, and leave anything else as text.
> 3. **Major**, `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:167`. The file still says "the start of the message counts as a line start (three leading spaces give `  `)". The `R443g` bytes give `   `. The spec was corrected, but this protocol file was not.
> 4. **Minor**, spec text that no longer matches the code: `:30` still says "pending 1" (twice); `:65` "pending 7": `R443g` now captures this; `:66` "CRLF removed … pending 5" contradicts the new row: the code now writes the `\r`; `:112` still mentions the "URL-word" exclusions, which were removed; `:121` still says "head index per colour" and "smiley's word", both removed. It lists none of the new loops, and still gives timings for 1 000 nested quotes, which now render only two levels.
> 5. **Minor**: `R443b` (smileys off), `R443h` and `R443k` are cited in the spec, but no test asserts them. I checked: each pair is equal at this head (`R443h` with `quoteShapeMapped(quotes: 4)`). Add them.
> 6. **Minor**: guesses that no capture shows and that pending item 11 does not list: `[#ff0000]x[/#f00]` renders (a 6-digit open closed by a 3-digit close); a `[b]` around a `[spoiler]` loses its tags, only the quote case is captured; the `)` spacing is not applied inside URLs; `(https://a.example/x)` links `…/x)`, closing parenthesis included. Also, intentional difference 3 (`[email]`) gives no reason.
>
> **Vérifié**: `swift test --filter BBCode` 41/41 green; swiftlint `--strict` clean on the changed files; red commit `fb77bc6`: all 9 batch 2 tests fail; every fact checked against the R443 bytes, the fact 7 wording in the issue is contradicted by `R443g`, as the spec says; R443f line by line: 10 lines equal, 5 differ; 12 new adversarial shapes: time ratio about 4x for 4x the size; no security finding.

Fixing all six in one commit.

Adversarial review, round 2 (Opus 5.5, read-only subagent), head e781341, verdict verbatim:

> **Revue adversariale (Opus 5.5) : APPROUVÉ** — tête e781341
>
> All round-1 items are fixed and match the capture bytes. In `R443f`, line 16 has `href="https://example.invalid/?a=1&b=&#034;2&#034;"` with the link text `&b="2"`, and the `img` src/alt/title follow the same rule. `[img]javascript:` and `[img]//host` stay text there, while `ftp://` and `page.html` render. HFR-PROTOCOL now says the start of the message is not a line start. `R443b`, `R443h` and `R443k` are asserted. No injection found, the fix commits are linear in time, and `R95d`/`R41a`/`R42`/`R41b` are still green. None of the findings below blocks the merge:
>
> 1. **Basse**, spec line 112 says the sanitization tests check rejected schemes "in `[img]` (removed)"; the test now asserts the tag stays text. Line 39 (pass 4) leaves out the scheme filter and the `&#034;` rule. Fix: align both lines.
> 2. **Basse**: behaviour no capture covers and Pending 11 does not list: `[img]HTTP://a.png[/img]` renders (scheme case-folded); `<` and `>` written `<`/`>` in an attribute and a typed `&` becoming `&amp;` (R443f only shows `"` and `&`); `[img] http://a.png[/img]` and `[img]javascript:http://a.png[/img]` come out with a bare-URL link inside the rejected tag. Fix: list them under "Guesses of #795".
> 3. **Détail**, `HFRBBCodeWriterTests.swift:153`: the test is titled "…once (R95d)" but asserts a `"` in an attribute is escaped twice. Rename it.
>
> **Vérifié**: `swift test --filter BBCode` passes (42 tests); `swiftlint --strict` clean; reverting `attributeEscaped` fails 4 tests, removing `schemes:` fails fact 9 and all 6 rejected-`[img]` cases; injection probes give no extra attribute and no markup; 20 000 × `[img]javascript:` is linear (0.16 s at 5k, 0.64 s at 20k).

The three minor findings are applied in the next commit (docs and a test name only, no code change, so the APPROVE stands on the code).
